name: phi-spaces-files
description: A Zanzibar-style filesystem for people and agent instances on phi-spaces: workspaces, inherited roles, revocation that every later operation sees

scripts.dev-cert: mkdir -p .local/tls && chmod 700 .local/tls && openssl req -x509 -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:P-256 -nodes -keyout .local/tls/key.pem -out .local/tls/cert.pem -days 365 -subj /CN=localhost -addext subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1 && chmod 600 .local/tls/key.pem
